caption: The drawing features a single piece of furniture—a cabinet with a rectangular shape—positioned centrally against a plain light beige background. The cabinet is made of brown wood and stands on four short legs, each with a small cut-out detail at the base. The front of the cabinet has two doors, each with an arch-topped panel design, and is fitted with small round knobs, one on each door. The top of the cabinet is a flat, stone-like surface depicted in a grayish color, contrasting with the dark brown wood. The sides of the cabinet also display recessed rectangular panels. Slight shadowing beneath the cabinet gives a sense of depth. Below the cabinet and slightly to the right, the name "Josabe Cannella" is written in small, uppercase, serif font in a muted blue color. There are no other objects or additional details in the composition.
title: Washstand
